title: SAFE-MEME: Structured Reasoning Framework for Robust Hate Speech Detection in Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking multimodal Vision Language Models and the proposed SAFE-MEME framework on the MHS and MHS-Con datasets to detect explicit and implicit hate speech targeting religious groups (e.g., Islam, Jewish community, Hinduism, Christianity).

Evaluating hate speech detection performance and conducting qualitative error analysis on vision-language models analyzing memes that target racial groups, specifically the African-American and White communities.
Testing multimodal models' ability to detect misogynistic and explicit/implicit hateful memes targeting women through structured visual and textual contextual reasoning and QA analysis.
Assessing the detection of hateful multimodal memes targeting individuals with mental and physical disabilities using precision, recall, and F1 scoring.
Measuring model accuracy and reasoning capabilities in identifying implicit and explicit memetic hate speech directed at the LGBTQ+ community.
Analyzing the performance and reasoning errors of vision-language models when detecting xenophobic and anti-immigrant hate speech in memes.
